A maintenance release. Nothing changes in how Malgel looks or behaves; the
check that guards every change no longer races the file it reads.

## Fixed

- The end-to-end test (`scripts/e2e/gui_smoke.sh`) could fail on a machine
  slower than the CI runner. Its last step types into the file a Find in Files
  hit opened, presses Ctrl+S, and then looked at the file — after a fixed
  0.4 seconds. When the write landed later than that, the check read the file
  early and reported a working feature as broken. The checks now wait for the
  file to change, so they assert on the result instead of on the clock.

## Changed

- The VS Code alignment notes now list the **current-line highlight** as done.
  It had been on the "what is left" list, but GPUI Kit's editor already paints
  the line the caret is on from the theme's `editor.active_line.background`,
  and both of Malgel's themes set that colour — no Malgel code was missing.
  Bracket matching, indent guides, Ctrl+D and Alt+↑/↓ line moves remain, as
  the editor library does not expose them yet.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Malgel-0.1.3-macos-universal.dmg`: open it and drag Malgel to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Malgel-0.1.3-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Malgel-0.1.3-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Malgel-0.1.3-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `malgel-0.1.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so Gatekeeper blocks it after download: right-click it and choose Open once, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Malgel.app`. The Windows files are unsigned: SmartScreen may warn, and **More info → Run anyway** gets past it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
